visual_effects.texture: Subtle noise overlay globally. Add a pseudo-element with a repeating noise pattern overlay at low opacity (e.g., 0.03) with pointer-events-none.
visual_effects.scanlines: Faint horizontal scanline pattern on hero section using repeating-linear-gradient(transparent, transparent 2px, rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 2px, rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 4px).

animations.scroll_reveal: Use framer-motion. Initial { opacity: 0, y: 30 } whileInView { opacity: 1, y: 0 } viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}.
animations.typewriter: Staggered text reveal mimicking command-line outputs for code blocks.
animations.flatline_heartbeat: SVG path animation transitioning from a flat amber line to an active cyan EKG/pulse heartbeat.
animations.node_pulse: CSS keyframe for a pulsating glowing ring (scale 1 to 1.5, opacity 1 to 0) around robot node markers.

robot_illustrations.strategy: Strictly SVG or CSS-drawn wireframe silhouettes. Avoid realistic images.
robot_illustrations.styling: Stroke-only paths in #00E5FF with 1px width, glowing drop-shadows filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(0,229,255,0.5)).

hero_background.description: Abstract mission control texture background to be placed at 10-20% opacity under the hero section.

sensor_abstract.description: Macro observability sensor. Use as a background for the Social Proof / Terminal section.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Strict adherence to APCA contrast for text on #050A0F and #0D1117. Secondary text must remain legible.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, and major section wrappers MUST have a descriptive 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'hero-waitlist-input', 'submit-email-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Never use raw HTML input for the waitlist form. Maintain styling control.
Ensure dark mode is permanent. Do NOT implement a light/dark toggle.
The 'How It Works' section must use a horizontal line or nodes connecting step 1, 2, and 3.
For the Pain section, the cards MUST use the warning (amber) glow effect explicitly.
For the Solution/Features section, the cards MUST use the primary (cyan) glow effect explicitly.

Create SVGs for the 5 robot types directly using 'lucide-react' icons if exact silhouettes are complex, or draw explicit SVGs. If using Lucide: Bot (Humanoid), Box/Truck (AMR), Claw/Combine (Arm), Dog (Quadruped), Plane/Drone (Drone).
